## 4. Pass pipeline {#llvm-pass-pipeline}

The pinned legacy and new pass-manager pipelines run `SIInsertWaitcnts` before an independent post-register-allocation hazard pass. The latter checks instructions in their final positions, including scheduling-region boundaries. This establishes an automatic handling path for recognized machine instructions and visible dependencies. [Legacy pipeline](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/4e9d349ab86dc0a913db3cba11aa2763d6985aff/llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/AMDGPUTargetMachine.cpp#L1838-L1874) · [New pipeline](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/4e9d349ab86dc0a913db3cba11aa2763d6985aff/llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/AMDGPUTargetMachine.cpp#L2593-L2624).

MFMA register hazards take a separate path through `GCNHazardRecognizer`. Its rules inspect opcodes, operand roles and physical register overlap, then account for intervening instructions. The [interface declarations](#compiler-target-lookup) establish types and target gates; they do not select a wider instruction automatically. [MFMA input checks](https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/4e9d349ab86dc0a913db3cba11aa2763d6985aff/llvm/lib/Target/AMDGPU/GCNHazardRecognizer.cpp#L3544-L3603).
